issue: Login fails when username is empty
fix: Add validation for empty username

issue: Application crashes when user is null
fix: Add null check before accessing user

issue: NoneType object has no attribute 'get' when config is missing
fix: Add null check before reading config values

issue: IndexError when accessing the first element of an empty list
fix: Check that the list is non-empty before indexing

issue: Off-by-one error causes the last item in the list to be skipped
fix: Fix the loop bound to include the last index

issue: Application crashes when dividing by zero in the discount calculation
fix: Add a check for zero before dividing

issue: Search endpoint is vulnerable to SQL injection
fix: Use parameterized queries instead of string concatenation

issue: Signup form accepts invalid email addresses
fix: Validate email format before creating the account

issue: API response is slow when the dataset has more than 10000 rows
fix: Add pagination and an index on the query column

issue: Application uses excessive memory when processing large CSV files
fix: Stream the file instead of loading it fully into memory

issue: File upload endpoint times out for large files
fix: Increase the timeout and stream the upload

issue: Application crashes with an unhandled exception when the file does not exist
fix: Wrap the file read in a try/except and return a friendly error

issue: Unhandled exception when the external API is unreachable
fix: Add a try/except around the API call with a retry

issue: Payment fails silently when the gateway times out
fix: Catch the timeout exception and surface an error to the user

issue: Discount calculation returns the wrong value for orders exactly at the threshold
fix: Fix the comparison operator from < to <= at the threshold

issue: Sorting function returns items in the wrong order for equal values
fix: Use a stable sort with a correct comparator

issue: Date parser returns the wrong month for dates in December
fix: Fix the off-by-one month index in the date parser

issue: Password reset link never expires
fix: Add an expiry timestamp and check it before allowing reset

issue: Application crashes when the config file is empty
fix: Add a default configuration and validate the loaded file

issue: Duplicate orders are created when the submit button is clicked twice
fix: Disable the submit button after the first click and debounce the request

issue: Cache is never invalidated after an update, returning stale data
fix: Invalidate the cache entry whenever the underlying data changes

issue: Application crashes on startup when a required environment variable is missing
fix: Validate required environment variables at startup and fail with a clear message

issue: Negative numbers are accepted in the quantity field
fix: Add a validation rule rejecting quantities less than one

issue: Application crashes when the API returns an empty response body
fix: Add a null/empty check before parsing the response JSON
